payload.title: Footer in docsite/build_site.py links Biblicus to anthusai.github.io/Biblicus/, which returns 404
payload.description:
**Problem**
The Markus docs site (https://markus.anth.us/) footer has a Biblicus link to a GitHub Pages site that does not exist. The same URL appears in the footer served on https://babul.us/, so this is a shared-footer problem, not only a Markus one.

**Evidence**
- docsite/build_site.py:242: `("Biblicus", "https://anthusai.github.io/Biblicus/", False),`
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L https://anthusai.github.io/Biblicus/` returns 404.
- `curl -s https://markus.anth.us/ | grep -o 'href="[^"]*Biblicus[^"]*"'` and the same against https://babul.us/ both show that URL.
- The shared footer registry (AnthusAI/anthus-footer, ~/Projects/anthus-footer, src/sites.js) already points Biblicus at https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus on main, so the sites serving the dead link are using a hardcoded or older-pinned copy.
- Root cause on the Biblicus side: its docs site is not published (separate Biblicus issue filed from this audit); once that is fixed the link works again.

**Fix**
Short term: point the Biblicus entry in build_site.py:242 at https://github.com/AnthusAI/Biblicus (matching anthus-footer's sites.js) or, better, consume the footer from anthus-footer instead of hardcoding it. Also update the footer's anth.us/blog link, which redirects to /articles.

**How to verify**
`curl -s https://markus.anth.us/ | grep -c 'anthusai.github.io/Biblicus'` returns 0 after the next docs deploy, and every footer link returns 200 (`curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L <url>`).

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
